expectation: Membrane CD3 on a distinct subset of immune cells (T cells), clearly separated from negative tissue. Expect dense clusters in lymphoid or tumour-infiltrating aggregates, scattered single cells in stroma and sparse or absent signal in parenchyma. Ring-like cells, not haze.
observed: A: yellow is patchy and concentrates in dense aggregates in several cores, with sparse single cells elsewhere and some cores nearly empty. B/C: a few discrete bright cells in mostly empty tissue. D: cell-scale yellow blobs, blurry at this zoom. E: CD3 forms dense regions that overlap with CD4 (white), plus CD3-only and CD4-only cells.
why: CD3 marks a distinct subset of cells that cluster in aggregates and scatter sparsely elsewhere, and it partly overlaps CD4, as expected for T cells.
